annotations.title: Settle placed bets (won / lost / push / void)

description: Hobby+ endpoint. Settles PLACED bets, singles or parlays, against final results: each comes back won, lost, push, void, half_won or half_lost, with actual_value (the stat or score it settled on), payout (stake included) and profit, plus a summary. The book and the line are free: a bet at a book PropLine does not carry, or at a line nobody posted, is graded by running PropLine's grader at that line (source='computed'); a named bookmaker whose outcome was stored at that exact line uses its own grade (source='stored'). Asian quarter lines (2.75, -0.25) settle as two half-stakes. result 'pending' means the game is not graded yet — say so, do not guess. 'unmatched' carries a reason (event_not_found, no_market_for_key, no_outcome_for_selection, ambiguous_selection, cannot_compute_at_line, invalid_bet): surface those rows. For a parlay pass legs (each with its own price); any lost leg loses it and pushed/voided legs drop out. Use propline_list_events or propline_get_scores to find event_id. Max 200 bets. Stateless. Free tier returns results as 'redacted'.

bets.description: Bets to settle. A single bet uses the leg fields directly; a parlay sets legs.

legs.description: Parlay legs; each has the single-bet fields above.
